feedback:
Selected the project using the web-based commander app. Selected the ui[] bits using the GUI as well.
Attached a LM07 SPI-based digital temperature sensor and displayed MSB-LSB on the onboard 7-segment display by using ui[2] to select between MSB and LSB. As shown in video below at room temperature it displays 28C although room temp was around 24C mostly because of the 2C resolution and accuracy as well. Then a soldering flow gun was to heat it up to 60+C and cooled again.
